vaccines.label: Enhanced
vaccines.zh: 加強型流感疫苗（佐劑或高劑量，未指明）

policy.title_zh: 公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 請符合資格民眾儘速接種 及早獲得保護力
policy.title_en: Public flu and COVID vaccinations strong; eligible people urged to get vaccinated soon for early protection
policy.summary: The CDC reports strong uptake of public flu and COVID vaccines, notes ongoing flu activity and severe cases, and urges eligible people to vaccinate early before the holiday travel period.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署報告公費流感與新冠疫苗接種踴躍，指出流感仍有活動且有重症病例，呼籲符合資格者在假期旅遊高峰前及早接種。
policy.why: CDC links ongoing severe flu activity to unvaccinated older adults and urges pre-holiday vaccination, framing the current severity narrative.
policy.why_zh: 疾管署將持續的流感重症疫情連結至未接種疫苗的長者，並呼籲連假前接種，形塑當前的重症敘事。

policy.title_zh: 「左流右新 護肺顧心」10月1日公費流感及新冠疫苗同步開打
policy.title_en: 'Left flu, right COVID, protect lungs and heart': public flu and COVID vaccines open together Oct 1
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC press release reports the October 1 launch of public flu and COVID vaccines and urges eligible people to get both, with the minister and officials receiving shots at the event.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署新聞稿表示，公費流感疫苗與COVID-19疫苗將於10月1日開打，並呼籲符合資格者兩種疫苗都要接種，部長與官員也於活動現場接種。
policy.why: Launch event confirmed 7.05 million flu doses procured including enhanced vaccine, the figure now used to judge supply adequacy.
policy.why_zh: 開打記者會確認採購705萬劑流感疫苗（含加強型），此數字現為評估供應是否充足的依據。

policy.title_zh: 2026年度公費流感及新冠疫苗第一階段將於10月1日開打 接種左流右新疫苗還可獲得1350健康幣
policy.title_en: 2026 publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccine first stage opens October 1; receiving Left flu, right new vaccines earns 1350 health coins
policy.summary: The CDC announces the first stage of publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccination starts October 1 for 11 groups, with a second stage from November 2, and urges eligible people to get vaccinated; standard and enhanced flu vaccine quantities and priority for enhanced vaccine in long-term care facilities are described.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布公費流感與新冠疫苗第一階段自十月一日起開始，對象為11類人群，第二階段自十一月二日起；並呼籲合格民眾接種，同時說明標準型與增強型流感疫苗的數量，以及長照機構優先使用增強型疫苗的規定。
policy.why: Sets the 2026 programme baseline: phase 1 for 11 groups from October 1 with about 6.449 million standard and 170,000 enhanced doses plus health-coin incentives.
policy.why_zh: 確立2026年計畫基準：第一階段10月1日起開放11類對象，約644.9萬劑標準型及17萬劑加強型疫苗，並搭配健康幣獎勵。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠於仍處流行期且流感疫情持續上升 呼籲民眾連假期間加強自主防疫 出現重症危險徵兆儘速就醫
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID still in epidemic period with flu rising; CDC urges self-protection during holiday and prompt care for danger signs
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC reports flu activity slightly rising and still epidemic, with 165 new severe cases and 30 deaths last week, and notes 67.8% of severe cases did not get this season's flu vaccine.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感活動度略為上升，仍屬流行期，上週新增165例重症及30例死亡，並指出67.8%的重症病例未接種本季流感疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 疾病管制署延長擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象「有類流感症狀，且具下列身分之流感高傳播族群」之適用期限至115年10月31日止，籲請醫師善用公費藥劑，共同防治流感。(疾病管制署致醫界通函第616號)
policy.title_en: CDC extends the period for expanded public flu antiviral use to October 31, 2026, for high-transmission groups with flu-like symptoms
policy.summary: The CDC notifies physicians that expanded public flu antiviral eligibility for high-transmission groups with flu-like symptoms is extended to October 31.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署通知醫師，針對具流感樣症狀之高傳播風險族群的公費流感抗病毒藥劑給付擴大措施，已延長至10月31日。

policy.title_zh: 目前流感疫情持續上升 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件將延長至今(115)年10月31日止
policy.title_en: Flu cases keep rising; expanded public flu antiviral eligibility extended to October 31, 2026
policy.summary: The CDC extends expanded public flu antiviral eligibility to October 31 as flu activity keeps rising, noting antivirals are not covered by National Health Insurance.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署因流感活動持續上升，將公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大給付條件延長至10月31日，並指出抗病毒藥劑不在健保給付範圍內。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠疫情均處流行期且流感疫情持續上升 呼籲民眾落實勤洗手 戴口罩等自我防護措施 並留意重症危險徵兆
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID-19 both in epidemic period; urges hand washing, masks and watching for severe warning signs
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC says flu is rising in epidemic period, urges protective measures and notes most severe cases were unvaccinated.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感疫情正進入流行期，呼籲採取防護措施，並指出多數嚴重病例未接種疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠仍有傳播風險 呼籲民眾出現症狀戴口罩就醫並在家休息 且留意重症危險徵兆
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID still pose transmission risk; people with symptoms urged to wear masks, seek care and watch for severe warning signs
policy.summary: The CDC says flu has entered its epidemic period, reports severe cases and deaths, and notes 68.6% of severe cases had not received this season's flu vaccine.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署表示流感已進入流行期，並通報嚴重病例與死亡案例，其中68.6%的嚴重病例未接種今年度流感疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 流感及新冠疫情持續 呼籲民眾留意個人衛生習慣 出現重症危險徵兆應儘速就醫治療
policy.title_en: Flu and COVID continue; public urged to practise hygiene and seek prompt care for severe warning signs
policy.summary: The CDC reports rising flu and COVID risk at school start, with 69.4% of severe flu cases this season unvaccinated, and urges hygiene and prompt care.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署報告開學時流感與新冠風險上升，本季重症流感病例中有69.4%未接種疫苗，並呼籲注意衛生與及時就醫。

policy.title_zh: 因應各級學校即將開學，疾管署呼籲學校與家長落實衛生防護，防範腸病毒、新冠、流感及登革熱疫情
policy.title_en: CDC urges schools and parents to take hygiene measures against enterovirus, COVID, flu and dengue as schools reopen
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC urges schools and parents to practise hygiene as schools reopen, reporting current COVID and flu activity and asking eligible people to get COVID vaccination.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署在開學之際呼籲學校與家長加強衛生習慣，說明目前COVID-19與流感的活動情形，並請符合資格者接種COVID-19疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 115年秋冬公費首度導入加強型流感及新世代新冠疫苗 疫苗株全更新精準防護 疾管署呼籲流感新冠同時打「左流右新 護肺顧心」
policy.title_en: Enhanced flu vaccine and new-generation COVID vaccine added to public autumn-winter programme; CDC urges getting both together
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC announces the first publicly funded enhanced flu vaccine for autumn-winter 2026, with updated strains and eligibility, and urges high-risk groups to get flu and COVID vaccines together.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布114年度秋冬首次納入公費的加強型流感疫苗，公布更新的病毒株與接種資格，並呼籲高風險族群同時接種流感與COVID-19疫苗。

policy.title_zh: 疾管署自今年8月24日至9月30日擴大公費藥劑使用對象(疾病管制署致醫界通函第613號)
policy.title_en: CDC letter No. 613: expanded public subsidised flu antiviral use from 24 August to 30 September
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC notifies clinicians that subsidised flu antiviral eligibility is expanded from 24 August to 30 September due to rising influenza-like illness visits.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署通知臨床醫師，因類流感門診就診人次上升，補助流感抗病毒藥物的適用範圍擴大，自8月24日至9月30日。

policy.title_zh: 國內外近期流感疫情緩升，疾管署自今年8月24日起至9月30日擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用條件
policy.title_en: Flu activity rising at home and abroad; CDC expands subsidised flu antiviral eligibility from 24 August to 30 September
policy.summary: The Taiwan CDC announces expanded eligibility for subsidised flu antivirals from 24 August to 30 September as influenza-like illness visits rise slightly.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署宣布，因類流感門診人次小幅上升，補助流感抗病毒藥物的適用範圍自8月24日至9月30日擴大。

policy.title_zh: 國內流感疫情雖尚未進入流行期，但已有緩升趨勢，以A型流感為主
policy.title_en: Domestic flu not yet epidemic but trending up, mainly influenza A
policy.summary: Taiwan CDC reports flu activity rising since early July, mainly influenza A, with severe cases and deaths mostly among older adults who were unvaccinated this season.
policy.summary_zh: 疾管署通報自7月初以來流感活動上升，以A型為主，重症與死亡個案多為本季未接種疫苗的長者。

headlines.title: 流感疫苗開打 南警六分局結合衛生所宣導交通安全
headlines.title_en: Flu vaccines open; Nanjing Police Precinct Six joins health station to promote traffic safety

headlines.title: 流感疫苗10月1日開打 「健康防護不可少，交通安全也重要」
headlines.title_en: Flu vaccines open October 1: health protection is essential, and traffic safety matters too

headlines.title: 流感疫苗護心效果等同戒菸！醫：心肌梗塞風險降三成
headlines.title_en: Flu vaccine protects the heart as much as quitting smoking; doctor says heart attack risk falls by 30%

headlines.title: 流感單週「44死、219重症」創近5年新高 百萬人急打疫苗
headlines.title_en: Weekly flu cases hit five-year high with 44 deaths and 219 severe cases; millions rush to get vaccinated

headlines.title: 竹市85歲以上長者優先打流感疫苗 三區衛生所推高齡友善一站式服務
headlines.title_en: Hsinchu City prioritizes flu shots for people aged 85 and over; three health stations offer senior-friendly one-stop service

headlines.title: 流感疫苗何時打？接種重點一次看
headlines.title_en: When to get a flu shot: key points at a glance

headlines.title: 流感疫苗免久等！85歲以上長者享優先通道高虹安市長：竹市三區衛生所推高齡友善優先接種服務
headlines.title_en: Flu shots without long waits: people aged 85 and over get priority; Mayor Hsinchu says three district health stations offer senior-friendly priority service

headlines.title: 流感單周重症219例、44死創上季新高 醫提醒慢性病族群要打疫苗
headlines.title_en: Weekly severe flu cases reach 219 with 44 deaths, highest since last season; doctor urges people with chronic illness to get vaccinated

headlines.title: 竹市高齡友善打流感疫苗 85歲以上長者有優先通道
headlines.title_en: Hsinchu flu shots for seniors: people aged 85 and over have priority access

headlines.title: 高雄流感奪35命！民眾搶打疫苗 高醫開注射區湧排隊人潮
headlines.title_en: Kaohsiung flu kills 35; people rush for vaccines and queue at Kaohsiung Medical University injection area

headlines.title: 流感疫情連假後趨緩 疫苗打氣旺8天近200萬人接種
headlines.title_en: Flu cases ease after holiday; nearly 2 million vaccinated in 8 days

headlines.title: 公費流感疫苗累計191萬人接種 新冠疫苗已65.5萬人施打
headlines.title_en: Public-funded flu vaccine cumulative total reaches 1.91 million; 655,000 COVID-19 vaccines given

headlines.title: 公費疫苗開打8天「流感近200萬人搶打」 新冠接種激增5成
headlines.title_en: Free public vaccine launched 8 days ago: nearly 2 million people rush for flu shots, COVID vaccinations up 50%

headlines.title: 連假出遊注意！流感絕非小感冒 糖心腎患者死亡風險增143%
headlines.title_en: Holiday travel caution: influenza is not a minor cold; death risk up 143% for kidney patients

headlines.title: 左新右流疫苗 設假日接種站
headlines.title_en: Left: COVID, right: flu vaccines; holiday vaccination stations set up

entries.headline: Weekly flu toll of 219 severe cases and 44 deaths dominates coverage
entries.why: Multiple outlets report a weekly peak, framed as a five-year high by some and 'highest since last season' by others. Severity is now the main frame driving urgency, with doctors targeting older and chronically ill people.
entries.headline_zh: 流感單週219例重症、44例死亡，成為報導焦點
entries.why_zh: 多家媒體報導單週數字達高峰，部分稱為五年新高，部分則稱「上季以來最高」。重症嚴重度已成為推升急迫感的主要框架，醫師呼籲對象鎖定長者及慢性病患。

entries.headline: Public flu uptake hits 1.91 million in eight days; official voices supply worry
entries.why: Lo Yi-chun publicly worried that supply may not be enough after 1.32 million doses in six days, a rare on-record signal of allocation pressure. Expect stakeholder questions on stock and stage-two readiness.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗8天接種達191萬劑；官方表態憂心供應
entries.why_zh: 羅一鈞公開表示，6天內已接種132萬劑，疫苗恐不敷使用，屬罕見的公開表態，顯示配送壓力。預期利害關係人將詢問庫存及第二階段準備情形。

entries.headline: Taiwan CDC reports strong uptake, urges eligible people to vaccinate before holidays
entries.zh: 公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 請符合資格民眾儘速接種 及早獲得保護力
entries.why: This is the agency's latest position: it links ongoing severe cases to an early-vaccination push. It sets the official tone that local bureaus in Kaohsiung, Keelung and Hsinchu are echoing.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署表示接種踴躍，呼籲符合資格者於連假前接種
entries.why_zh: 此為疾管署最新立場：將持續出現的重症連結至及早接種的呼籲，並定調官方口徑，高雄、基隆、新竹等地衛生局皆跟進呼應。

entries.headline: Users report self-pay flu stock gaps and single-brand clinics; Kaohsiung queues reported
entries.why: Posts say Kaohsiung clinics told callers self-pay vaccine arrives only in November and that public clinics stock one brand. News separately reports hospital queues after 35 Kaohsiung deaths, so access friction is becoming a local story.
entries.headline_zh: 網友反映自費流感疫苗缺貨、診所僅有單一廠牌；高雄傳出排隊人潮
entries.why_zh: 貼文指出，高雄診所告知來電民眾自費疫苗11月才到貨，公費診所僅備有單一廠牌。另有新聞報導，高雄35人死亡後醫院出現排隊人潮，接種可近性問題正成為地方議題。

entries.headline: Enhanced and adjuvanted vaccine claims circulate via doctors, media and a clinic post
entries.why: Doctors urge older adults toward the enhanced vaccine, and a clinic post (131 engagements) makes comparative efficacy and duration claims for an adjuvanted product. That raises advertising-compliance and reputational exposure for the category.
entries.headline_zh: 加強型及含佐劑疫苗相關宣稱經由醫師、媒體與診所貼文流傳
entries.why_zh: 醫師呼籲長者接種加強型疫苗，一則診所貼文（131次互動）針對某含佐劑產品提出比較性效力與保護期宣稱，提高此品類的廣告合規與聲譽風險。

entries.headline: Parents confused by child two-dose rule; fever posts after nasal and injected shots
entries.why: A reported dosing change for 6-month to 3-year-olds is producing conflicting clinic answers. Parent posts about fever after vaccination are drawing engagement, a likely pediatric hesitancy pocket.
entries.headline_zh: 家長對兒童兩劑規定感到困惑；鼻噴及注射型疫苗接種後發燒貼文
entries.why_zh: 據報6個月至3歲幼兒的劑次規定有所調整，各診所說法不一。家長分享接種後發燒的貼文引發互動，可能形成兒科疫苗猶豫的局部族群。

watch.text: Second stage of the publicly funded flu programme opens. Watch whether early supply concerns lead to allocation changes or messaging on stock.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打。關注先前的供應疑慮是否導致配送調整或庫存相關說明。

watch.text: 150,000 Novavax COVID doses are reported to start as part of the joint 'left flu, right COVID' campaign, which may refresh dual-shot safety questions.
watch.text_zh: 據報15萬劑Novavax新冠疫苗將納入「左流右新」聯合接種活動開始施打，可能再度引發同時接種兩劑的安全性疑問。

watch.text: Posts say Kaohsiung clinics expect self-pay flu stock only then. One outlet also says flu will not ease until November. Track access complaints and severity reporting.
watch.text_zh: 貼文指出高雄診所預計屆時才有自費流感疫苗；另有媒體稱流感疫情要到11月才會趨緩。持續追蹤接種可近性抱怨與重症報導。

narratives.title: Public flu and COVID programme uptake surge
narratives.title_zh: 公費流感及新冠疫苗接種人數激增
narratives.para: Coverage tracks fast public-programme uptake, about 1.91 million flu doses in eight days, often paired with official worry that supply may not keep pace.
narratives.para_zh: 報導追蹤公費疫苗快速接種情形，8天內約191萬劑流感疫苗，並常伴隨官方對供應恐跟不上的憂慮。

narratives.title: Autumn public flu and COVID vaccine launch
narratives.title_zh: 秋季公費流感及新冠疫苗開打
narratives.para: Launch-day framing of the October 1 'left flu, right COVID' rollout is giving way to local campaigns, holiday clinic sites and explainer guides.
narratives.para_zh: 10月1日「左流右新」開打首日的報導框架，正逐漸轉向地方宣導活動、連假接種站及說明指南。

narratives.title: Record flu severe cases and deaths
narratives.title_zh: 流感重症及死亡創新高
narratives.para: Multiple outlets report 219 weekly severe cases and 44 deaths, described as a five-year high, with ICU doctors saying severe patients were unvaccinated.
narratives.para_zh: 多家媒體報導單週219例重症、44例死亡，稱為五年新高；加護病房醫師表示重症患者皆未接種疫苗。

narratives.title: Health coin incentives and local rewards
narratives.title_zh: 健康幣獎勵與地方獎勵措施
narratives.para: Health coin rewards and local lucky draws are credited with lifting uptake, alongside reports of app registration and access problems for older adults.
narratives.para_zh: 健康幣獎勵及地方抽獎被認為有助提升接種率，但也有報導指出長者在App登錄及接種可近性上遇到困難。

narratives.title: Supply strain, stock-outs and self-pay access
narratives.title_zh: 供應吃緊、缺貨與自費接種可近性
narratives.para: Users report self-pay doses unavailable until November and clinics stocking a single public-programme brand, as officials voice supply concerns.
narratives.para_zh: 網友反映自費疫苗11月前無法取得、診所僅備單一公費廠牌，官方亦表達供應疑慮。

narratives.title: Enhanced and adjuvanted vaccines for older adults
narratives.title_zh: 長者用加強型及含佐劑疫苗
narratives.para: Doctors urge enhanced vaccines for older adults and the CDC prioritises them in long-term care, while percentage-based efficacy claims circulate in media and clinic posts.
narratives.para_zh: 醫師呼籲長者接種加強型疫苗，疾管署優先將其配置於長照機構，同時媒體與診所貼文流傳以百分比表示的效力宣稱。

narratives.title: Older adult priority access and uptake pace
narratives.title_zh: 長者優先接種與接種進度
narratives.para: Reports cite about 11% of people 65+ vaccinated in the first four days and local priority lanes such as Hsinchu's for those aged 85 and over.
narratives.para_zh: 報導指出前4天約11%的65歲以上長者已接種，地方亦設有優先通道，如新竹針對85歲以上長者。

narratives.title: Child dosing rules and nasal spray questions
narratives.title_zh: 兒童劑次規定與鼻噴疫苗疑問
narratives.para: Parents ask about the revised two-dose rule for young children and conflicting clinic advice, while doctors present nasal spray as an option for needle-averse children.
narratives.para_zh: 家長詢問幼兒兩劑規定的修訂及診所建議不一致，醫師則將鼻噴疫苗作為怕打針兒童的選項。

narratives.title: Chronic disease and cardiovascular risk framing
narratives.title_zh: 慢性病與心血管風險框架
narratives.para: Doctors frame vaccination around elevated risk for diabetes, kidney, heart and chronic lung patients, with reports of cardiovascular benefit studies and respiratory vaccine recommendations for COPD and asthma.
narratives.para_zh: 醫師以糖尿病、腎臟病、心臟病及慢性肺病患者的較高風險為接種訴求，亦有心血管效益研究報導，以及針對COPD和氣喘患者的呼吸道疫苗建議。

narratives.title: Side-effect experiences and safety doubts
narratives.title_zh: 副作用經驗與安全性疑慮
narratives.para: High-engagement posts log post-shot symptoms and child fevers, while a small set of opposed posts make misleading claims about vaccine contents and dual-shot safety.
narratives.para_zh: 高互動貼文記錄接種後症狀與兒童發燒，少數反對貼文則對疫苗成分及同時接種兩劑的安全性提出誤導性說法。

narratives.title: Japan's early season and regional demand
narratives.title_zh: 日本流感季提早與區域需求
narratives.para: Reports of Japan's early flu surge are linked to travel risk and Taiwan vaccine demand, with no new coverage in the last three days.
narratives.para_zh: 日本流感提早升溫的報導被連結至旅遊風險及台灣疫苗需求，近3天無新報導。

narratives.title: Maternal RSV vaccination and infant protection
narratives.title_zh: 孕婦RSV疫苗接種與嬰兒保護
narratives.para: A post summarising a European real-world study on prenatal RSV vaccination and infant hospitalisation marks early RSV conversation, noting recommendations vary by country.
narratives.para_zh: 一則摘要歐洲孕期RSV疫苗接種與嬰兒住院真實世界研究的貼文，象徵RSV討論初現，並提及各國建議不一。

voices.text: A person reports that two Kaohsiung clinics said self-paid flu vaccine will not be available until November.
voices.text_zh: 有人反映，高雄兩家診所表示自費流感疫苗要到11月才會供應。

voices.text: A parent says several mothers reported fever after nasal spray flu vaccine and asks whether to choose an injection for their child instead.
voices.text_zh: 有家長表示，多位母親反映接種鼻噴式流感疫苗後出現發燒，因此詢問是否應為孩子改選注射型疫苗。

voices.text: A clinic promotes an adjuvanted flu vaccine, claiming 20 to 30 percent better protection and 12 months of coverage, and invites people to get it at its clinic.
voices.text_zh: 一家診所宣傳含佐劑流感疫苗，聲稱保護力提升20至30%、可維持12個月，並邀請民眾至診所接種。

voices.text: A parent describes two children getting the nasal flu vaccine, one developing fever about 36 hours later that lasted roughly two days before resolving, and says they recovered.
voices.text_zh: 一位家長描述兩名孩子接種鼻噴式流感疫苗，其中一人約在三十六小時後發燒，持續約兩天後退燒，並表示孩子已康復。

voices.text: A post claims that flu, measles, varicella, hepatitis B and HPV vaccines contain or use viruses and says a local office's call for seniors to get vaccinated endangers them.
voices.text_zh: 一則貼文宣稱流感、麻疹、水痘、B型肝炎與HPV疫苗含有或使用病毒，並認為地方機關呼籲長者接種會危害其健康。

voices.text: A post summarises a European pooled real-world study linking prenatal RSV vaccination to about 74% relative risk reduction in infant RSV hospitalisation, and notes the figure is relative and recommendations vary by country.
voices.text_zh: 一篇貼文整理歐洲多國合併真實世界研究，指出產前接種RSV疫苗可使嬰兒RSV住院相對風險降低約74%，並提醒此數字為相對值，且各國建議不同。
